decisions.statement: An hour rather than a day gathers the readings.
The hour is read in UTC off the instant the scan has.
The instant is the epoch milliseconds the scan states.
The instant is read back as UTC text.
The hour is titled by its day and its hour.
The hour page is written only where the store has no hour page yet.
A reading already there for that account at that instant counts as landed.
A line has no key joining the account to the milliseconds.
The parts a reading broke its total into are written only where that reading broke a part out.
A total of zero is written rather than left out.
The commit message names the total rounded to gold and the instant.
Each attempt reads the hour afresh.
The caller mints the id a new hour page carries.
Nothing here names the writer or how many attempts are made.
Nothing here works out a reading's total.

definition: a net worth reading landed as one jsonl line on the UTC hour it was taken in
